The ggplot2 theme BlackThriveSS charts use

Source: R/theme.R
btg_theme.Rd

A quiet theme built on ggplot2::theme_minimal(): a recessive hairline grid, no minor grid or tick marks, titles aligned with the plot edge, muted axis text and the legend above the plot. btg_plot_disparity() applies it, and it can be added to any other ggplot.

Usage

btg_theme(base_size = 12)

Arguments

base_size

Base font size in points.

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(colour = btg_colours()[["bar"]]) +
  btg_theme()
